about: Truthful outcomes of a capture gone stale (external audit CMB-004, CMB-014; lab PR 217): on a host without nft, a /dev/shm payload (StagingExec, ENGAGED) is refused a write to the agent's state (COMBAT locked); its soft egress block fails — a signed record of its own, the INVESTIGATE window shortened to 10 s. The payload exits and logrotate takes its pid. At the shortened deadline NEUTRALIZE reaches for the captured process: gone, and the process that holds the pid now is not touched; nothing on disk to quarantine. Contained (nothing left of the offender): no isolation.
